test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the following three-letter words:

(Left) NAT PAL COT TAN (Right)

If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
solution:
The given three letter words are: (Left) NAT PAL COT TAN (Right)

If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, we get:

→ (Left) **OBU QBM DPU UBO** (Right)

Here, we can see that there is one word (QBM) which has no vowel.

Hence, the correct answer is **"One"**.
